description: Defines the GrainInterfaceType struct and related interface and attribute for identifying and retrieving grain interface types in Orleans.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceType
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a grain interface, providing equality operations and serialization features.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: An interface for retrieving GrainInterfaceType instances from a Type.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfaceTypeProvider
classes.description: An implementation of IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider that uses attributes to determine the GrainInterfaceType.

classes.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProviderAttribute
classes.description: An attribute interface that provides a method for getting a GrainInterfaceType from a service provider and a type.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeAttribute
classes.description: Attribute applied to interfaces to specify their GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.Create
methods.description: Creates a new GrainInterfaceType instance from a string value.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.Equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between two GrainInterfaceType instances.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceType.ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the underlying IdSpan.

methods.name: IGrainInterfaceTypeProvider.TryGetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Attempts to get a GrainInterfaceType for a given Type.

methods.name: AttributeGrainInterfaceTypeProvider.TryGetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Iterates over custom attributes of a type to find a matching GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceTypeAttribute.GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the GrainInterfaceType specified by the attribute.
